column1: # Motion target value domains — ESX Bank Studio
# Source: Korg ESX-1 Owner's Manual p.71 (MOTION DEST / MOTION VALUE table),
#         cross-checked against the part-parameter reference (manual p.53-54)
# Every target additionally accepts the per-step sentinel "Disabl" = do not update at this step.
# smooth: Y = honours the part's SMOOTH setting
#         FORCED_TRIG = always plays back stepped/latched even when SMOOTH is selected (manual p.69)
# KNOWN ERRATUM IN THE KORG MANUAL
# p.71 prints "Revers(REVERSE)  Disabl, 0...127". This is a typo.
# The parameter reference (manual p.53) states "REVERSE ... On, Off" and REVERSE appears in the
# forced-TRIG-HOLD list on p.69, which contains only discrete parameters. Corrected to boolean above.
# The adjacent FxSend row IS printed correctly: the parameter reference likewise states
# "FX SEND ... On, Off" (it is a routing switch, not a send amount).
# Both must be confirmed byte-level in Spike B against a real bank.
# VALID TARGETS BY PART TYPE (manual p.68)
# drum 1-7B, stretch 1-2, slice:  Pitch EGTime Pan Level SttPoint AmpEG Roll Revers FxSend FxSel
#                                 ModSpd ModDpt ModBPM ModTyp ModDst Cutoff EGInt Reso FltTyp
# keyboard 1-2:                   as above but Glide replaces Pitch, plus OSC EDIT 1 / OSC EDIT 2
# audio in:                       EGTime Pan Level AmpEG Roll FxSend FxSel
#                                 ModSpd ModDpt ModBPM ModTyp ModDst Cutoff EGInt Reso FltTyp
#                                 (no Pitch, no Start Point, no Reverse)
# accent:                         LEVEL only, and always TRIG HOLD
# effects FX1/2/3:                Edit1, Edit2 only, and always SMOOTH
